mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals tightening monetary conditions, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3 percentage points within three months indicates weakening labor market conditions, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE rose by more than 0.3 percentage points within three months.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% within a month signals a weakening demand in the housing market, which often leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where HOUST dropped by more than 5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within a month signals strengthening supply-side conditions, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% over three months signals deflationary pressure, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL decreased by more than 0.5% over three months.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points within a month, it signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000 and UNRATE decreased by more than 0.2 percentage points within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A consistent increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where RSAFS increased consistently over three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) increases by more than 1% and GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 2% within a quarter, it signals robust economic growth, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases > 1% and GDPC1 grows > 2% in 1 quarter
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% and GDPC1 grew by more than 2% within a quarter.
